{{Quote|The plague's spiraling out of control. The rakghouls are getting stronger. The virus isn't just infecting sentients anymore. It's spreading through the local wildlife. My patrols have no idea how to handle it.|Byzal|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Byzal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the security forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was overtaken by an [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], Kaon was the fifth planet to be hit, and Byzal tried to maintain the quarantine. However, shortly after offworld reinforcements arrived, a shuttle attempted to break quarantine, and Byzal was infected by a [[rakghoul]] while investigating the crash site. He transformed not long afterwards and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Byzal appears in the Flashpoint Kaon Under Siege, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1.<ref name="TOR" />
